question: Can the first Futamura-style observation be executed inside the declared research data-machine profile: a compiler, written in the same language as the interpreter it replaces, emitting a residual program for each source program of a frozen family, with residual execution agreeing with interpretation under a declared observation and with the source-to-residual correspondence and the forgotten structure retained?
level: Bounded construction and executed calibration of one declared transformation; no stable specializer, no general partial evaluator, no host-language compiler change and no self-hosting claim
imports: docs/RESEARCH_ENGINEERING_AGENDA.md section 1.5 step 5 and section 4 ask for exactly this calibration and name the evaluator as the interpreter of the first projection
The frozen arithmetic interpreter at programs/bounded-interpreter/interpreter.adva, 51 instructions, tags 0 literal, 1 addition, 2 multiplication, unchanged

The 129 frozen regular trees retained in experiments/bounded_native_interpreter/evidence/attempt-1/primary.tar.gz, unchanged, with a direct recursive arithmetic oracle as the independent expected value
Declared profile bounds: 128 program instructions, 16 registers, 127 data nodes, depth 12, arity 8, lifetime fuel 2048
interface: The compiler is built from the interpreter by a declared rule: every instruction up to the interpreter's final return is kept byte for byte, that return becomes a jump into an appended emission epilogue, and the epilogue folds the completed value into residual program data. The residual encoding R is declared: a program node with tag 7 whose fields are instruction nodes, tag 0 constant value dst, tag 2 box_integer src dst, tag 1 return src, instantiated by the checker because this profile has no loader instruction.
observation: The returned integer value and the run status. The execution trace is deliberately not compared: compilation is expected to change it, and treating trace equality as the correctness condition would forbid specialization.
protected: The interpreter and the machine are unchanged; no bound is widened and no new operation is added
The source-to-residual correspondence is explicit: the compiler's relation to the interpreter is checked instruction by instruction, and every emitted residual is retained
The forgotten structure is named: tree shape, literals and evaluation order do not survive into the residual
The compile cost is recorded beside the residual cost, so a one-shot compile is not presented as a free gain
Equality is checked over the whole declared family of 129 trees and against an independent oracle, not on a few values
cases: 129 frozen the-family trees, each interpreted, each compiled, and each compiled residual instantiated and executed directly
the interpreter body of the compiler is compared with the frozen interpreter instruction by instruction
one interpreted run is compared byte for byte with the frozen campaign's own retained run artifact
success: For every one of the 129 trees the interpreted value, the directly executed residual value and the independent oracle agree; the compiler is the interpreter plus the declared epilogue; and every cost and residual is retained.
negative_controls: The independent recursive oracle is a third implementation, so equal values cannot come from one shared evaluation path
A residual is executed directly as an instantiated program, never through the interpreter, so the residual's own semantics is what is measured
The compile cost is summed with the residual cost, so the classical one-shot compile penalty is visible rather than hidden
Any disagreement in any of the 129 cases fails the attempt
exit: Stop at the first mismatch or resource limit; retain the failure and publish no positive claim from this attempt.
limits: This is the first projection for a fully static source family: the source program is the whole input, so no dynamic input survives and every residual is a constant. Projections two and three need the compiler to be a program in the language it specializes, which the declared bounds do not admit; that is measured, not assumed. Nothing here is a stable specializer, a general partial evaluator, a speedup claim for real hardware, or a self-hosting compiler.
